title: Delta Industrial Automation InfraSuite Device Master DeSerializeBinary Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Delta Industrial Automation InfraSuite Device Master Device-Monitor. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target client must connect to a malicious server. The specific flaw exists within the DeSerializeBinary function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user.
